details: Vince Cyriac is a full-stack developer based in Kerala, India, who finds beauty at the intersection of clean code and thoughtful design. He works at LiteBreeze AB as a front-end specialist building interfaces between humans and machines. When not in the terminal, he explores edge tech, and on weekends he goes completely offline probably on his bike.
browser_preference: use Google Chrome Dev for personal tasks, Google Chrome for work
time_preference: Always provide the current time in Indian Standard Time (IST) unless another timezone is explicitly mentioned.
